scale_anchor.source: Nominal architectural height used as an unverified modelling assumption. No external survey or website accessed.

observed_features: Eight outward-flared stacked main facade tiers
Dense vertical mullions and horizontal glazing/spandrel rhythm
Teal curtain wall and pale metallic corner trim
Two large circular facade medallions at lower tower transition
Smaller flared upper crown with repeated cornices
Tall cylindrical shaft and ringed tapering antenna

assumptions.ScaleSource: 508 m nominal total height chosen as unverified anchor; all proportions interpreted from one photograph
assumptions.HiddenGeometry: Opposite exterior faces mirrored; lower envelope extended to assumed ground. No interior partitions, core, stairs, services or hidden floor slabs. Surroundings omitted.
assumptions.DetailPolicy: Curtain wall facades and spandrel plates, explicit mullion lattices, simplified ruyi brackets, medallions, cornices and spire. Estimated 101 storeys; floor numbering is interpretive.

detail_policy.glazing: Continuous curtain-wall envelopes with explicit mullions, spandrels and grouped darker vision plates; darker-pane distribution is representative, not pane-by-pane surveyed.
detail_policy.geometry_precision: Vertices authored on a 1/32768 m grid for lossless Blender float32 transfer of this 508 m model.
detail_policy.excluded: Interior partitions, cores, stairs, services, hidden floor slabs, neighbors and landscaping.
detail_policy.ornaments: Ruyi and crown terrace motifs simplified to visible silhouette members.

stopping_reason: Envelope, selected landmarks, semantic model and appearance linkage verified. Further reconstruction of fine ornaments, reflections or hidden geometry is not supported sufficiently by this single reference.
